algebra-distributive-partial.label: Distributed to the first term only
algebra-distributive-partial.watchFor: Draw the area model — the outside factor touches BOTH terms.

decimal-place-value.label: Right digits, wrong magnitude
decimal-place-value.watchFor: Estimate to the nearest whole first, then count decimal places out loud.

exponent-as-multiplication.label: Multiplied the base by the exponent
exponent-as-multiplication.labelEs: Multiplicó la base por el exponente
exponent-as-multiplication.watchFor: Expand it once — write out every factor before evaluating.

fraction-added-denominators.label: Added the denominators
fraction-added-denominators.watchFor: Return to a bar model — thirds plus fifths cannot become eighths.

fraction-no-reciprocal.label: Divided fractions without inverting
fraction-no-reciprocal.watchFor: Ask them to check with a whole-number case they already trust.

fraction-straight-across-division.label: Divided numerators and denominators straight across
fraction-straight-across-division.watchFor: Reground division as “how many of these fit into that?”

geom-triangle-area-no-half.label: Found base × height but forgot the half
geom-triangle-area-no-half.labelEs: Calculó base × altura pero olvidó la mitad
geom-triangle-area-no-half.watchFor: Draw the rectangle around the triangle — the triangle is half of it.

geom-volume-added-dimensions.label: Added the dimensions instead of multiplying
geom-volume-added-dimensions.labelEs: Sumó las dimensiones en vez de multiplicarlas
geom-volume-added-dimensions.watchFor: Build one layer of unit cubes first, then count the layers.

measure-area-perimeter-swap.label: Swapped area and perimeter
measure-area-perimeter-swap.watchFor: Ask what the unit should be — units or square units?

op-added-instead-of-multiplied.label: Added when the problem multiplies
op-added-instead-of-multiplied.watchFor: Ask what the operation *does* to the quantity before they compute.

op-divided-instead-of-multiplied.label: Divided when the problem multiplies
op-divided-instead-of-multiplied.watchFor: Estimate first — should the answer be bigger or smaller than you started?

op-multiplied-instead-of-added.label: Multiplied when the problem adds
op-multiplied-instead-of-added.watchFor: Have them restate the problem as a story, then name the operation.

op-multiplied-instead-of-divided.label: Multiplied when the problem divides
op-multiplied-instead-of-divided.watchFor: Estimate first — should the answer be bigger or smaller than you started?

op-reversed-division.label: Divided in the wrong order
op-reversed-division.watchFor: Ask “what is being split, and into how many?” before they write it.

op-reversed-subtraction.label: Subtracted in the wrong order
op-reversed-subtraction.watchFor: Anchor both numbers on a number line before subtracting.

order-of-operations-left-to-right.label: Worked left to right instead of by operation order
order-of-operations-left-to-right.labelEs: Trabajó de izquierda a derecha en vez de por orden de operaciones
order-of-operations-left-to-right.watchFor: Have them circle the operation that must go first, then compute.

percent-scale-off-by-100.label: Percent answer off by a factor of 100
percent-scale-off-by-100.labelEs: Respuesta de porcentaje errada por un factor de 100
percent-scale-off-by-100.watchFor: Benchmark against 50% and 10% before trusting the number.

percent-used-as-whole-number.label: Used the percent as a plain number
percent-used-as-whole-number.labelEs: Usó el porcentaje como número entero
percent-used-as-whole-number.watchFor: Make them say the percent as “per hundred” out loud.

rate-not-per-one.label: Gave the total instead of the unit rate
rate-not-per-one.labelEs: Dio el total en vez de la tasa unitaria
rate-not-per-one.watchFor: Ask “per ONE what?” and make them finish the sentence.

ratio-inverted.label: Flipped the ratio
ratio-inverted.watchFor: Have them label both quantities with units before writing the ratio.

sign-dropped.label: Right magnitude, lost the negative sign
sign-dropped.labelEs: Magnitud correcta, perdió el signo negativo
sign-dropped.watchFor: Place the answer on a number line — which side of zero?

stat-summed-instead-of-averaged.label: Added the data set instead of averaging it
stat-summed-instead-of-averaged.labelEs: Sumó el conjunto de datos en vez de promediarlo
stat-summed-instead-of-averaged.watchFor: Ask whether the answer could be a realistic single value in that set.
